target_customer: Consumers who want remote personal training, paying about 30 dollars a month
problem: Online workout apps lack accountability and generic plans ignore the individual; in-person trainers are expensive.
business_model: Consumer subscription (about $30 per month per Product Hunt listing) pairing a human trainer with AI-generated workouts
product_category: Hybrid human and AI remote fitness coaching

founders.name: Ajay Saini
previous_startups: PepTales (co-founder, per YC page; outcome not found)
founders.background_notes: YC page gives no bio, education or employers. A search summary of the YC listing also named Vahid Fazel-Rezai but the fetched YC page showed only Ajay Saini, so he is not recorded as a founder.

technical_complexity.rationale: A workout-generation engine plus a chat and coaching app is standard consumer software; no source describes anything research-grade.

defensibility.rationale: A hybrid coaching service with commodity AI planning was easy to copy; no data or network moat is documented.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source describes what incumbents did. A Product Hunt page and a 2026 coaching roundup show human-plus-app coaching offers existing later, but nothing dated to 2020 was found.

market_need_then: Fitness demand shifted online during the 2020 pandemic as gyms closed; no Overfit-specific demand data was found.

identity.logo: Not described in any source found

brand_strength.rationale: No press or brand material found; only Product Hunt and aggregator listings.

outcome_analysis: The YC directory marks Overfit Inactive and no founder statement, post-mortem or acquisition notice was found, so the cause of the stop is not public. It raised about 500 thousand dollars per one aggregator from YC and angels and launched a 30 dollar a month hybrid coaching product, but no traction numbers surfaced.
notes: overfit.com did not resolve from this session (host not allowed or dead). The 500K figure and investors rest on a single database (CB Insights); no date. A third-party directory speculated about the failure reason without a source and is not used.
